correctness.rationale: Proof verifies the longest simple path in any complete multipartite induced subgraph, unique dominant-part criterion, disjoint pivot pairing of every simplex of size >=t, and acyclicity through impossibility of second gradient step. The full (t-2)-skeleton establishes (t-3)-connectivity; discrete Morse bounds CW dimension by t-2, so Hurewicz and Whitehead yield a wedge. Reduced Euler computation uses a finite alternating binomial identity. The packaged script exhaustively verifies path tests, pairings, acyclicity, mod-two homology and Euler formula in examples; finite verification is corroboration only. t>N is handled as contractible simplex.

value.rationale: Extends the closest 2026 full bipartite topology result to every complete multipartite graph with >=3 parts and all thresholds >=5, including the known nonshellable range, with a closed formula for every integral Betti rank. The uniform acyclic matching is structural and allows exact computations without exponential complexes, e.g. K_{4,4,4} gives 306 three-spheres at t=5 and 378 four-spheres at t=6. Neither known shellability thresholds nor a single finite test implies this theorem; the general gap is mathematically motivated.
